raw_segments.text: I could not bear to return to the sordid village, where besides no prospect of aid was visible.
I should have longed rather to deviate to a wood I saw not far off, which appeared in
its thick shade to offer inviting shelter.
But I was so sick, so weak, so gnawed with nature's cravings, instinct kept me roaming
round abodes where there was a chance of food.
